# WE ADVANCE NUCLEAR SECURITY BY DEVELOPING INDUSTRY-LEADING CONTAINMENT SOLUTIONS

Container Technologies Industries, LLC (CTI Fab) is your trusted partner for superior quality metal
fabrication services. Based in Tennessee, CTI Fab provides innovative design and engineering
solutions with expertise in mechanical, civil, structural, and nuclear engineering, delivering
precision, quality, and reliability for every project.

CTI Fab has delivered ASME Nuclear Quality Assurance-1 containers to the U.S. Department of Energy,
U.S. Department of Defense, commercial nuclear industry, and chemical industry for over 25 years.
 With over 300 container designs and a team of expert engineers and fabricators, we are well
equipped to provide containers and other metal fabricated products on time and to the highest
quality standards.

[

Get a quote

][7]

# TRUSTED BY

# OUR VALUES

# A HIGHER STANDARD

Ever since our founding in 1999, we have prioritized three virtues in all that we do. These values
unite our team of professional engineers, AWS D1.1 & D1.3 welders and SNT-TC-1A Certified Level II
inspectors under one goal: to fulfill your project better than anyone else.

Engineering

Our solutions are meticulously designed, considering every detail to ensure precision and efficiency
in all of our projects.

Quality

We deliver products that perfectly align with your specifications, maintaining the highest standards
of accuracy and craftsmanship.

Safety

Our people are at the heart of the company, so we foster a safe work environment that reflects our
commitment to our team.

[

READ MORE ABOUT OUR PROCESS

][8]

# OUR PRODUCTS

# WHAT WE CAN CREATE

Whether you need something off-the-shelf, lightly customized, or a ground-up design, we can bring it
to reality. Throughout the discovery process, our skilled team will work with yours to figure out
the best solution to your project.

## OUR SERVICES

With global knowledge and local expertise, our team offers advice on all aspects of containerization
including Leasing, Sales, One-Way Move, and Container Fleet Management.

### Container Leasing

Seaco began leasing containers in the 1960’s and is now one of the world’s leading container
lessors. Our flexible leasing options include Operating Lease and Finance lease suitable for short-
and long-term durations including sale and leaseback.

[CONTAINER LEASING][61]

### Container Sales

Seaco regularly sells from our large and diverse fleet. Suitable for portable storage,
transportation, or modification projects. Containers are available from a global network of depot
locations.

[CONTAINER SALES][62]

### One-Way Move

One-Way Move, provides customers the option to lease a container which can be picked up at one
location and returned to another location, subject to Seaco’s terms and conditions.

[ONE-WAY MOVE][63]

## THE SEACO DIFFERENCE

### FLEXIBILITY & CUSTOMIZATION

Seaco offers flexible short to long-term container leasing options, helping customers to maximize
the benefits of utilizing Seaco and their own fleets. Our new containers are manufactured to high
specification and custom design solutions are available to suit specific and technical requirements.

### CUSTOMER SERVICE OPERATIONS

Our people are the backbone of Seaco.  We are proud to have an international and dedicated team of
qualified and experienced industry representatives, who are committed in ensuring our global
operating structures are efficiently equipped to support the global and local needs of our
customers.

### GLOBAL REACH

Seaco has established office representation in Americas, EMEIA, Asia and Oceania. Regionally and
globally, we are able to support international trade from our diverse fleet of equipment.

### UNMATCHED INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE

Seaco has a proud history spanning 60 years. In the pioneer years of containerization, we were
directly involved in the manufacturing of containers.  Collaborating with leading manufacturers,
Seaco has been responsible for product innovation and influencing many major advances in the
technical design and construction of shipping container equipment.  Seaco’s shared technical
knowledge bank enables our team to confidently advise and support customers on the right container
types and fleet strategies.

### QUALITY & SAFETY

Through continuous investment in research and development, Seaco’s fleet of containers are built to
high specification, to help reduce operating, maintenance, and repair costs. All our containers are
inspected to ensure they are compliant with international regulations, industry certifications and
approvals.

### INNOVATIVE SOLUTIONS

Seaco has a history of product innovation
and providing flexible leasing solutions for our customers.   We are a member of the UN Global
Compact Network – UK, but across the world, Seaco is also committed to comply to the principles of
human rights, labor, environment, and anti-corruption.  We are on a transformational journey,
adopting best practices and influencing the global supply-chain on container leasing.

# Corporate Overview

Trinity Industries, Inc. owns market-leading businesses that provide railcar products and services
in North America under the trade name TrinityRail®. TrinityRail’s unique platform provides a single
source for comprehensive rail transportation solutions that optimizes our customers’ ownership and
usage of railcar equipment and enhances the value-proposition of the rail modal supply chain.

Our purpose is to Deliver Goods for the Good of All. We remain committed to rail solutions that
deliver goods—safely, efficiently, and sustainably - for the good of our customers, shareholders,
and employees in all the communities we serve.

Trinity reports its financial results in two principal segments: the Railcar Leasing and Management
Services Group and the Rail Products Group. 
Our common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange and NYSE Texas under the symbol TRN.

[More About Us][35]

[Busy avenue]

## Delivering Goods for the Good of All™

It’s more than a motto — it’s our purpose. Rail transports the goods that keep our lives, our
communities, and our economy thriving, and TrinityRail is proud to keep North America’s rail
shippers moving forward.

TrinityRail is an industry-leading railcar leasing company, enhanced by our manufacturing and
service capabilities. We are a leader in providing leasing and logistics services, and act as an
integrated and strategic partner to stakeholders across the industry. We are on a mission to
increase rail’s modal share and convenience by delivering more sustainable, end-to-end solutions
that bridge the first and last miles for our customers.[ ][36]

# CORPORATE
# OVERVIEW

# Corporate Overview

Trinity Industries, Inc. owns market-leading businesses that provide railcar products and services
in North America under the trade name TrinityRail®. TrinityRail’s unique platform provides a single
source for comprehensive rail transportation solutions that optimizes our customers’ ownership and
usage of railcar equipment and enhances the value-proposition of the rail modal supply chain.

Our purpose is to Deliver Goods for the Good of All. We remain committed to rail solutions that
deliver goods—safely, efficiently, and sustainably - for the good of our customers, shareholders,
and employees in all the communities we serve.

Trinity reports its financial results in two principal segments: the Railcar Leasing and Management
Services Group and the Rail Products Group. 
Our common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange and NYSE Texas under the symbol TRN.

[More About Us][35]

[Busy avenue]

## Delivering Goods for the Good of All™

It’s more than a motto — it’s our purpose. Rail transports the goods that keep our lives, our
communities, and our economy thriving, and TrinityRail is proud to keep North America’s rail
shippers moving forward.

TrinityRail is an industry-leading railcar leasing company, enhanced by our manufacturing and
service capabilities. We are a leader in providing leasing and logistics services, and act as an
integrated and strategic partner to stakeholders across the industry. We are on a mission to
increase rail’s modal share and convenience by delivering more sustainable, end-to-end solutions
that bridge the first and last miles for our customers.[ ][36]

[Locations map]

### meaningful contributions to address our long-term impact.

### BIC Codes

Container Owner Codes

The international register of container owner codes

[Learn More][74]

### BoxTech

Global Container Database

The global container database — giving carriers, terminals, shippers and other partners instant
access to technical data on 15M+ containers. Free, non-profit, operated by BIC.

[Learn more][75]

### BIC Facility Codes

Container Facility Database

A unique, harmonized code to identify container facilities and their locations, with an API serving
both BIC and SMDG facility codes

[Learn more][76]

### Geofence Library

Container Facilities

Harmonized Geofences for BIC- and SMDG-coded facilities to support smart container use globally

[Learn more][77]
[BIC Code Register]

### Why use a BIC Code?

The international register of identification codes was originated by BIC in 1970

[Learn More][78]

### Check Digit Calculator

The container check digit provides a means of validating the transmission accuracy of the
owner/operator code and serial number.

[Learn More][79]

### BIC APIs

The BIC is supporting digitalization initiatives in the container shipping industry by providing
standardized codes for the supply chain.

[Learn More][80]
[BIC: Bureau of International Containers]

### What is the BIC?

### Publisher of the BIC Code Register since 1970, the Bureau International des Containers
### (International Container Bureau), or BIC, was appointed by the International Organization for
### Standardization (ISO) in 1972 as the industry’s global container prefix registry, a role further
### endorsed by International Customs Conventions, and currently has over 3,100 container-operating
### members in 127 countries.

### Publisher of the BIC Code Register since 1970, the Bureau International des Containers

### Standardization (ISO) in 1972 as the industry’s global container prefix registry, a role further

shipping containers. Specially if the container is sitting on a soft ground, if the weight
distribution not done properly the container may sink and container door can not open and close
easily. Elevation of the container is very important as well as the leveling.

# Industrial Containers, Steel & Plastic Drums For Sale

[55-gallon-drum-client][55-gallon-drum-client]

Container Distributors, Inc. supplies a full range of industrial containers engineered for regulated
waste, chemical handling, and material transport. Our inventory includes steel drums, plastic drums,
steel barrels, fiber drums, drum liners, and specialty containers used across environmental,
industrial, and hazardous‑material operations.

As a national supplier based in St. Louis, we support customers who need reliable solutions for
**hazardous waste containers**, chemical packaging, and compliant disposal workflows. Our team
provides knowledgeable guidance on selecting the right container type, including UN‑rated
**55‑gallon steel drums** to lightweight **plastic drums** and rugged **fiber drums** used for lab
packs, absorbents, and dry materials.

We maintain a wide range of [in‑stock items][48] that meet current DOT, EPA, and UN performance
standards for the shipment and storage of regulated materials. With fast delivery, responsive
customer service, and a deep understanding of compliance requirements, Container Distributors, Inc.
is your single source for:
* [Steel drums][49] & steel barrels
* Plastic drums & tight‑head/open‑head options
* Fiber drums & specialty lightweight containers
* Drum liners for liquids, solids, and corrosive materials
* IBC totes, pails, salvage drums, overpack drums
* 55‑gallon drums, buckets, barrels, and cubic‑yard boxes

[REQUEST A QUOTE][50]

## Hazardous Waste Container for Hazardous Material Handling

[poly-drum-white-bg][poly-drum-white-bg]

When hazardous waste must be contained, transported, or consolidated, the packaging you choose
directly affects compliance, safety, and operational efficiency. A properly rated **hazardous waste
container** ensures your materials remain secure throughout handling and disposal.

Container Distributors’ hazardous waste container lineup includes durable **fiber drums**, rigid
**steel drums**, chemical‑resistant **plastic drums**, and compatible **drum liners** designed for
lab packs, chemical waste, pharmaceutical disposal, and regulated solids or liquids. Each container
type is tested to meet UN performance standards for drop resistance, leak prevention, and structural
integrity.

Our UN‑approved boxes and drums support a wide range of volumes, from small 3‑gallon fiber drums to
full‑size 66‑gallon hazardous waste containers. Whether you need a lightweight option for dry
materials or a heavy‑duty steel barrel for aggressive chemicals, we provide solutions that balance
strength, certification, and cost efficiency.

Explore our complete selection of hazardous waste containers engineered for safe, compliant
hazardous‑material handling across environmental, industrial, and waste‑management operations.

[LEARN MORE][51]

it.][A Buckets/Pails Polyethylene Container in white with a metal handle and a separate lid beside
it.]

ratings, DOT placards, and regulatory expectations helps ensure that every container in your
facility supports safe handling and compliant storage.

# Industrial Containers, Steel & Plastic Drums For Sale

[55-gallon-drum-client][55-gallon-drum-client]

Container Distributors, Inc. supplies a full range of industrial containers engineered for regulated
waste, chemical handling, and material transport. Our inventory includes steel drums, plastic drums,
steel barrels, fiber drums, drum liners, and specialty containers used across environmental,
industrial, and hazardous‑material operations.

As a national supplier based in St. Louis, we support customers who need reliable solutions for
**hazardous waste containers**, chemical packaging, and compliant disposal workflows. Our team
provides knowledgeable guidance on selecting the right container type, including UN‑rated
**55‑gallon steel drums** to lightweight **plastic drums** and rugged **fiber drums** used for lab
packs, absorbents, and dry materials.

We maintain a wide range of [in‑stock items][48] that meet current DOT, EPA, and UN performance
standards for the shipment and storage of regulated materials. With fast delivery, responsive
customer service, and a deep understanding of compliance requirements, Container Distributors, Inc.
is your single source for:
* [Steel drums][49] & steel barrels
* Plastic drums & tight‑head/open‑head options
* Fiber drums & specialty lightweight containers
* Drum liners for liquids, solids, and corrosive materials
* IBC totes, pails, salvage drums, overpack drums
* 55‑gallon drums, buckets, barrels, and cubic‑yard boxes

[REQUEST A QUOTE][50]

## Hazardous Waste Container for Hazardous Material Handling

[poly-drum-white-bg][poly-drum-white-bg]

When hazardous waste must be contained, transported, or consolidated, the packaging you choose
directly affects compliance, safety, and operational efficiency. A properly rated **hazardous waste
container** ensures your materials remain secure throughout handling and disposal.

Container Distributors’ hazardous waste container lineup includes durable **fiber drums**, rigid
**steel drums**, chemical‑resistant **plastic drums**, and compatible **drum liners** designed for
lab packs, chemical waste, pharmaceutical disposal, and regulated solids or liquids. Each container
type is tested to meet UN performance standards for drop resistance, leak prevention, and structural
integrity.

Our UN‑approved boxes and drums support a wide range of volumes, from small 3‑gallon fiber drums to
full‑size 66‑gallon hazardous waste containers. Whether you need a lightweight option for dry
materials or a heavy‑duty steel barrel for aggressive chemicals, we provide solutions that balance
strength, certification, and cost efficiency.

Explore our complete selection of hazardous waste containers engineered for safe, compliant
hazardous‑material handling across environmental, industrial, and waste‑management operations.

[LEARN MORE][51]

## What You Need to Know About Hazardous Waste Containment

[A Buckets/Pails Polyethylene Container in white with a metal handle and a separate lid beside
it.][A Buckets/Pails Polyethylene Container in white with a metal handle and a separate lid beside
it.]

Safe hazardous waste containment depends on choosing containers that match the chemical and physical
properties of your waste stream. From steel drums and HDPE containers to fiberboard boxes and IBC
totes, each option plays a specific role in preventing leaks, spills, and exposure. Understanding UN
ratings, DOT placards, and regulatory expectations helps ensure that every container in your
facility supports safe handling and compliant storage.

If your operation manages corrosive liquids, reactive materials, contaminated solids, or mixed waste
streams, the right containment strategy can significantly reduce risk.

## What **Differentiates** Us

Container Management, Inc. is a multi-generational family-owned and -operated container Wholesaler,
founded in 1993 to serve our customers with exemplary customer service and competitive wholesale
pricing.



﻿We are a leading national provider of both new and used shipping and storage containers to industry,
private individuals, and the global export market. 

Unrivaled industry knowledge and expertise

## About Container Management, Inc.

Our mission is to provide our customers with an excellent purchase experience, offering competitive
wholesale pricing and top-quality service.  As a leading national wholesale provider, we specialize
in new and used shipping and storage containers for a wide range of markets, including industry,
private individuals, and the global export market.



At Container Management, Inc., we believe in a personalized, customer-centric approach.  We're not a
call center; we are a dedicated team of professionals committed to building long-term relationships
and ensuring your satisfaction every step of the way.  Every container we sell is inspected to
guarantee it is wind and water-tight, providing you with a reliable storage or project solution. 



With over 32 years of industry expertise, and inventory at more than 32 depots across the
continental U.S.,  we offer a wide variety of shipping containers and provide a professional 
delivery service to your location, making your experience convenient and trouble-free.

WHY DP WORLD?

## ANYTHING. ANYWHERE.

No matter your size or sector, we can help you scale your trade through our global end-to-end
infrastructure. From local entrepreneurs to global enterprises, we connect you to the markets,
resources, and opportunities that matter most. 

MAKE AN IMPACT

DP World plays a vital role in keeping global trade moving by connecting economies, industries and
businesses worldwide. 

A SINGLE PLATFORM FOR TRADE

chain. That's the DP World advantage.

### Frequently Asked Questions

What types of shipments can I track using your platform?
E-tracking offers real-time updates for all carriers, including container tracking, cargo tracking,
air cargo tracking, post/ems tracking, courier tracking, package tracking, and more.
How do I track my shipment?
Simply enter your tracking number into our search bar and click "Track". Our platform will then
provide you with real-time updates on the status of your shipment.
Is the tracking platform free to use?
Yes, our tracking service is completely free to use.
Is there a limit to how many shipments I can track?
No, our platform allows you to track as many shipments as you need, all in one place.
Do I need to create an account to use the tracking platform?
No, you can track your shipments without creating an account. However, creating an account allows
you to save your tracking information and receive notifications for updates.
What carriers and shipment types does the tracking platform support?
The tracking platform supports all carriers and shipment types, including domestic and international

## About Us

EZ Box Wholesale is a dedicated supplier of high-quality wholesale shipping containers for resellers
across the United States. With a focus on providing a seamless wholesale buying experience, we stand

brokering other’s inventory.

Who can buy from EZ Box Wholesale?

customers’ demands.

How do I check inventory availability?

###### Our Mission

## Simplify the process of tracking shipping containers

Our intuitive and easy-to-navigate [interface][13] ensures a seamless user experience, even for
beginners. We prioritize data accuracy to provide you with reliable and up- to-date information
about your containers. Rely on our platform to make informed decisions and mitigate risks.

###### API Integration

## Discover findTEU container tracking service features

### Info for business

[Find out more][14]

We transform 700+ raw carrier events into 15 standardized milestones and ETAs for seamless
processing and sharing across IT systems.

We standardize location names to UNLOCODE to consolidate data, eliminate duplicates, and provide a
complete view of your container updates.

We offer a custom reference field to add specific identifiers, like P.O. or invoice numbers,
enabling you to link container tracking data directly to orders or clients in your database.

We cover 93% of global trade, including all major shipping lines, as well as leased and
shipper-owned containers.

Our solution saves you at least one minute of labor time per container each day compared to manual
tracking and data processing.

### Info for developers

[Find out more][15]

Our API is designed for quick and seamless integration, making it easy for developers to embed
real-time container tracking with minimal effort.

With unlimited quantity of API calls, developers can access data as frequently as needed without
restrictions.

Custom reference fields, such as P.O. numbers or client IDs, allow you to link tracking data
directly to internal systems for streamlined data association.

An optional webhook feature enables automatic posting of tracking updates, reducing manual checks
and ensuring real-time information flow.

Our 24/7 technical support team is always available to assist with any issues, ensuring smooth
operation and minimal downtime.

###### API Integration

## Discover findTEU container tracking service features

### Info for business

[Find out more][14]

We transform 700+ raw carrier events into 15 standardized milestones and ETAs for seamless
processing and sharing across IT systems.

We standardize location names to UNLOCODE to consolidate data, eliminate duplicates, and provide a
complete view of your container updates.

We offer a custom reference field to add specific identifiers, like P.O. or invoice numbers,
enabling you to link container tracking data directly to orders or clients in your database.

We cover 93% of global trade, including all major shipping lines, as well as leased and
shipper-owned containers.

Our solution saves you at least one minute of labor time per container each day compared to manual
tracking and data processing.

### Info for developers

[Find out more][15]

Our API is designed for quick and seamless integration, making it easy for developers to embed
real-time container tracking with minimal effort.

With unlimited quantity of API calls, developers can access data as frequently as needed without
restrictions.

Custom reference fields, such as P.O. numbers or client IDs, allow you to link tracking data
directly to internal systems for streamlined data association.

An optional webhook feature enables automatic posting of tracking updates, reducing manual checks
and ensuring real-time information flow.

Our 24/7 technical support team is always available to assist with any issues, ensuring smooth
operation and minimal downtime.

## YOUR ONE SOURCE IN NORTHERN AMERICA

Proven leader in reliability and service.

**LUMMID CONTAINERS** is one of North America’s leading providers of new and used shipping
containers. We are your single source for a wide range of wholesale containerized shipping products,
including specialty equipment such as 10fts, Open Sides, DuoCons, Hazmat, Half High and offices.
Military specific equipment like BiCons, TriCon and QuadCons. Contact us to help you with all your
wholesale container and intermodal equipment needs.

[ contact us ][27]

## WHY THEY CHOSE US

[Aerial view of Shanghai port with shipping containers and cranes]

### One of North Americans leading Providers

Lummid Containers is one of North America’s leading providers of new, used and specificity shipping
containers in North America.

[Worker inspecting shipping container for export quality control]

### trusted source and industry leading reputation

Supplying containers and intermodal equipment to the industry since 2000 has made us an industry
leader and trusted source in the wholesale market.

[Shipping containers stacked in port under cranes during loading operations]

### Large network of maritime equipment

Lummid provides equipment nationally out of both Container Depots and Terminals; maintaining one of
the largest networks of maritime equipment in North America. As well as building and shipping
equipment directly to your facility.

Lummid Containers is one of North America’s leading providers of new and used shipping containers in
North America. Supplying containers and intermodal equipment to the industry since 2000 has made us
an industry leader and trusted source in the wholesale market. Lummid provides equipment out of 50
States and 359 Container Depots and Terminals nationwide: maintaining one of the largest networks of
maritime equipment in North America. This includes new and used 20 foot, 40 foot, and 40 foot high
cube units, as well as, specialty equipment such as reefers, open tops, flat racks, gensets along
with Military equipment and custom built units. With over 20 years of experience in the intermodal
industry and wholesale market Lummid Containers can fill wide array of container equipment needs.

## YOUR ONE SOURCE IN NORTHERN AMERICA

Proven leader in reliability and service.

**LUMMID CONTAINERS** is one of North America’s leading providers of new and used shipping
containers. We are your single source for a wide range of wholesale containerized shipping products,
including specialty equipment such as 10fts, Open Sides, DuoCons, Hazmat, Half High and offices.
Military specific equipment like BiCons, TriCon and QuadCons. Contact us to help you with all your
wholesale container and intermodal equipment needs.

[ contact us ][27]

[Aerial view of Shanghai port with shipping containers and cranes]

### One of North Americans leading Providers

Lummid Containers is one of North America’s leading providers of new, used and specificity shipping
containers in North America.

leader and trusted source in the wholesale market.

[Shipping containers stacked in port under cranes during loading operations]

Lummid provides equipment nationally out of both Container Depots and Terminals; maintaining one of
the largest networks of maritime equipment in North America. As well as building and shipping
equipment directly to your facility.

Lummid Containers is one of North America’s leading providers of new and used shipping containers in
North America. Supplying containers and intermodal equipment to the industry since 2000 has made us
an industry leader and trusted source in the wholesale market. Lummid provides equipment out of 50
States and 359 Container Depots and Terminals nationwide: maintaining one of the largest networks of
maritime equipment in North America. This includes new and used 20 foot, 40 foot, and 40 foot high
cube units, as well as, specialty equipment such as reefers, open tops, flat racks, gensets along
with Military equipment and custom built units. With over 20 years of experience in the intermodal
industry and wholesale market Lummid Containers can fill wide array of container equipment needs.

## Our process for vetting reputable and reliable movers

Moving.com works hard to connect customers with **reputable moving companies** they can trust. Every
mover in our network goes through a vetting process designed to promote professionalism,
reliability, and transparency.

### How We Evaluate Moving Companies

*Licensing & Registration*
  We verify that interstate movers are properly registered with the U.S. Department of
  Transportation (USDOT) and authorized to perform interstate moves. Local movers must meet
  applicable state and local licensing requirements.
*Insurance Coverage*
  Movers in our network are required to carry appropriate insurance to help protect customers�
  belongings during the moving process.
*Industry Experience*
  We look for moving companies with demonstrated experience handling household moves, including
  local, long-distance, and interstate relocations.
*Business Practices & Compliance*
  We evaluate movers based on business history, compliance with industry regulations, and adherence
  to professional moving standards.
*Ongoing Monitoring*
  Our vetting doesn�t stop after onboarding. Moving.com continuously reviews movers in our network
  to help ensure ongoing quality and accountability.

## Moving Services We Help You Find

*

### [Full-service Movers][117]

*
  Full-service movers handle local and interstate moves from beginning to end. Services offered by
  full-service movers include packing, unpacking, loading and unloading, transportation, customer
  support, furniture assembly and disassembly and more. Our residential and commercial moving
  companies offer the full-service capabilities you need to make your move successful.
*

### [Local Movers][118]

*
  Don't need long-distance moving services? Whether you're moving across the street or the state,
  our nationwide network of local moving companies is a great option when moving nearby. Intrastate
  movers typically charge an hourly rate and offer loading and transportation services.
*

### [Auto Shipping][119]

*
  Need to move your car to the new home? Save mileage by hiring an auto transport company to
  transport your vehicle. When you submit your auto transport move request through us, we'll send
  you [car shipping][120] quotes from our many licensed and insured auto transport partners.
*

### [Do-It-Yourself Services][121]

*
  If you're taking on a DIY move, you'll need a moving truck. Compare quotes and offerings from
  trusted truck rental companies directly through our site.
*

### [Moving containers][122]

*
  A cost-effective way to move, portable moving containers offer a hybrid approach to moving. Moving
  containers also double as storage units, so you can store your belongings before, during or after

## Our process for vetting reputable and reliable movers

Moving.com works hard to connect customers with **reputable moving companies** they can trust. Every

reliability, and transparency.

### How We Evaluate Moving Companies

*Licensing & Registration*
  We verify that interstate movers are properly registered with the U.S. Department of
  Transportation (USDOT) and authorized to perform interstate moves. Local movers must meet
  applicable state and local licensing requirements.
*Insurance Coverage*
  Movers in our network are required to carry appropriate insurance to help protect customers�
  belongings during the moving process.
*Industry Experience*
  We look for moving companies with demonstrated experience handling household moves, including
  local, long-distance, and interstate relocations.
*Business Practices & Compliance*
  We evaluate movers based on business history, compliance with industry regulations, and adherence
  to professional moving standards.
*Ongoing Monitoring*
  Our vetting doesn�t stop after onboarding. Moving.com continuously reviews movers in our network
  to help ensure ongoing quality and accountability.

  Full-service movers handle local and interstate moves from beginning to end. Services offered by
  full-service movers include packing, unpacking, loading and unloading, transportation, customer
  support, furniture assembly and disassembly and more. Our residential and commercial moving
  companies offer the full-service capabilities you need to make your move successful.

*
  Don't need long-distance moving services? Whether you're moving across the street or the state,
  our nationwide network of local moving companies is a great option when moving nearby. Intrastate
  movers typically charge an hourly rate and offer loading and transportation services.

### [Auto Shipping][119]

*
  Need to move your car to the new home? Save mileage by hiring an auto transport company to

*

### Instant Access to Warehousing & Distribution Nationwide

OLIMP Warehousing connects businesses to flexible, on-demand warehousing and logistics solutions
across the U.S. and Canada. With access to 5,000+ warehouse locations, we help you secure space
exactly when and where you need it-no long-term contracts, just fast, efficient support.

Our platform simplifies the search and booking process with instant quotes, vetted providers, and
dedicated customer service. Whether you need overflow storage, fulfillment support, or a long-term
warehousing partner, OLIMP delivers scalable solutions to keep your supply chain moving.
[Book Local Warehouse Space][67]
[Discover the ideal warehousing and fulfillment partner for your business, providing tailored
storage and order fulfillment solutions.]

### Flexible Warehousing & Fulfillment Solutions

We deliver tailored warehousing solutions for businesses of all sizes, from [on-demand short-term
storage][68] for freight brokers and distributors to large-scale [warehouse space for retailers][69]
and manufacturers. Our services adapt to your industry’s needs: we can accommodate special
requirements like [temperature-controlled storage][70] for perishable goods or handling of oversized
equipment. In addition, we offer on-demand fulfillment support for e-commerce operations, enabling
you to manage order distribution efficiently without investing in your own warehouse infrastructure.
By partnering with OLIMP, you gain a reliable warehousing and fulfillment ally that gives you
flexibility and control over your logistics as your business grows.
[Browse Fulfillment Services][71]
[Forklift moving goods inside a large warehouse specializing in storage and warehousing services.]

### Speed Up Deliveries with Cross-Docking Services

Cross-docking through OLIMP’s network keeps your freight moving fast by transferring shipments
directly from incoming trucks to outgoing trucks with little to no storage time in between. This
practice minimizes handling and storage costs while accelerating delivery times. Our on-demand
platform gives you instant access to cross-dock facilities nationwide whenever and wherever you need
them, helping you avoid delays and keep your supply chain lean. By combining cross-docking with our
coordinated [delivery services ][72] we ensure your goods reach their next destination quickly and
efficiently.
[Book Cross Docking Service][73]
[Truck unloading goods at a warehouse for fast cross docking and delivery.]

### Smart and Affordable Shipping with Consolidated Freight

OLIMP’s consolidated freight service helps you ship more efficiently by combining smaller loads
headed in the same direction into a single shipment. Rather than paying for half-empty trucks or
containers, you only pay for the space you actually use, an approach that can significantly lower
your transport costs (up to 25% savings in some cases).

Consolidation is ideal for LTL (less-than-truckload) or LCL (less-than-container-load) freight that
doesn’t fill an entire trailer on its own. Our team handles all the planning and coordination,
grouping compatible shipments and scheduling them for departure. You get a reliable delivery with
full transparency along the way, and no wasted space or budget.
[View Freight Consolidation Services][74]
[Forklift moving pallets in a warehouse as part of a consolidated freight shipment for efficient
transport.]

### Fast Freight Rework & Pallet Restacking

If a shipment is delayed due to shifted pallets, damaged goods, or a load rejection at a receiver,
OLIMP can get it back on track quickly. We provide prompt, reliable freight rework and pallet
restacking services through our warehouses across North America, handling everything from minor
pallet damage to completely shifted loads. Our experienced teams will unload, inspect, and re-stack
or repackage your freight as needed to meet all delivery and compliance standards. With OLIMP
handling your rework needs, you can minimize downtime and avoid costly penalties, ensuring your
corrected shipment is ready for re-delivery.
[Request a Rework Quote][75]
[Warehouse workers restacking and reworking freight on pallets to prepare for re-delivery after load
rejection.]

### Seamless Port-to-Warehouse Transloading & Drayage Solutions

Our transloading and drayage services bridge the gap between ports and warehouses, making
international and intermodal shipping smoother. OLIMP arranges the swift transfer of your cargo from
ocean containers to trucks or rail at the port, helping you avoid congestion and hefty demurrage or
detention fees. With operations available 24/7 and specialized equipment to handle sensitive or
heavy freight, we ensure your goods are safely moved from the port to a warehouse without delay. You
can trust our certified drayage partners for reliable first- and last-mile transportation of your
containers – keeping your imports and exports on schedule from ship to shore.
[See Transloading Services][76]
[OLIMP's efficient port transloading and container drayage services that reduce freight delays and
costs.]

### Unlock New Income by Registering Your Warehouses

If you operate a retail, general, bonded, industrial or cold‑storage facility, OLIMP can help you
monetize unused space. Our platform verifies and matches your warehouse with businesses looking for
trustworthy storage solutions. Once registered, you can showcase your capabilities and start
generating new revenue without additional marketing effort.
[Offer Your Warehousing Services][77]

### Instant Access to Warehousing & Distribution Nationwide

OLIMP Warehousing connects businesses to flexible, on-demand warehousing and logistics solutions
across the U.S. and Canada. With access to 5,000+ warehouse locations, we help you secure space
exactly when and where you need it-no long-term contracts, just fast, efficient support.

Our platform simplifies the search and booking process with instant quotes, vetted providers, and
dedicated customer service. Whether you need overflow storage, fulfillment support, or a long-term
warehousing partner, OLIMP delivers scalable solutions to keep your supply chain moving.
[Book Local Warehouse Space][67]
[Discover the ideal warehousing and fulfillment partner for your business, providing tailored
storage and order fulfillment solutions.]

### Flexible Warehousing & Fulfillment Solutions

We deliver tailored warehousing solutions for businesses of all sizes, from [on-demand short-term
storage][68] for freight brokers and distributors to large-scale [warehouse space for retailers][69]
and manufacturers. Our services adapt to your industry’s needs: we can accommodate special
requirements like [temperature-controlled storage][70] for perishable goods or handling of oversized
equipment. In addition, we offer on-demand fulfillment support for e-commerce operations, enabling
you to manage order distribution efficiently without investing in your own warehouse infrastructure.
By partnering with OLIMP, you gain a reliable warehousing and fulfillment ally that gives you
flexibility and control over your logistics as your business grows.
[Browse Fulfillment Services][71]
[Forklift moving goods inside a large warehouse specializing in storage and warehousing services.]

### Speed Up Deliveries with Cross-Docking Services

Cross-docking through OLIMP’s network keeps your freight moving fast by transferring shipments
directly from incoming trucks to outgoing trucks with little to no storage time in between. This
practice minimizes handling and storage costs while accelerating delivery times. Our on-demand
platform gives you instant access to cross-dock facilities nationwide whenever and wherever you need
them, helping you avoid delays and keep your supply chain lean. By combining cross-docking with our
coordinated [delivery services ][72] we ensure your goods reach their next destination quickly and
efficiently.
[Book Cross Docking Service][73]
[Truck unloading goods at a warehouse for fast cross docking and delivery.]

### Smart and Affordable Shipping with Consolidated Freight

OLIMP’s consolidated freight service helps you ship more efficiently by combining smaller loads
headed in the same direction into a single shipment. Rather than paying for half-empty trucks or
containers, you only pay for the space you actually use, an approach that can significantly lower
your transport costs (up to 25% savings in some cases).

Consolidation is ideal for LTL (less-than-truckload) or LCL (less-than-container-load) freight that
doesn’t fill an entire trailer on its own. Our team handles all the planning and coordination,
grouping compatible shipments and scheduling them for departure. You get a reliable delivery with
full transparency along the way, and no wasted space or budget.
[View Freight Consolidation Services][74]
[Forklift moving pallets in a warehouse as part of a consolidated freight shipment for efficient
transport.]

### Fast Freight Rework & Pallet Restacking

If a shipment is delayed due to shifted pallets, damaged goods, or a load rejection at a receiver,
OLIMP can get it back on track quickly. We provide prompt, reliable freight rework and pallet
restacking services through our warehouses across North America, handling everything from minor
pallet damage to completely shifted loads. Our experienced teams will unload, inspect, and re-stack
or repackage your freight as needed to meet all delivery and compliance standards. With OLIMP
handling your rework needs, you can minimize downtime and avoid costly penalties, ensuring your
corrected shipment is ready for re-delivery.
[Request a Rework Quote][75]
[Warehouse workers restacking and reworking freight on pallets to prepare for re-delivery after load
rejection.]

### Seamless Port-to-Warehouse Transloading & Drayage Solutions

Our transloading and drayage services bridge the gap between ports and warehouses, making
international and intermodal shipping smoother. OLIMP arranges the swift transfer of your cargo from
ocean containers to trucks or rail at the port, helping you avoid congestion and hefty demurrage or
detention fees. With operations available 24/7 and specialized equipment to handle sensitive or
heavy freight, we ensure your goods are safely moved from the port to a warehouse without delay. You
can trust our certified drayage partners for reliable first- and last-mile transportation of your
containers – keeping your imports and exports on schedule from ship to shore.
[See Transloading Services][76]
[OLIMP's efficient port transloading and container drayage services that reduce freight delays and
costs.]

If you operate a retail, general, bonded, industrial or cold‑storage facility, OLIMP can help you
monetize unused space. Our platform verifies and matches your warehouse with businesses looking for
trustworthy storage solutions. Once registered, you can showcase your capabilities and start
generating new revenue without additional marketing effort.

# The AI that *really* does things.

Organizes your inbox, sends emails, manages your calendar, checks you in for flights.
All from WhatsApp, Telegram, or any chat app you already use.

[Get started][16] [Read the docs][17]

## Quick Start

install
One-liner npm Hackable Apps
npm pnpm
installer pnpm
macOS & Linux Windows
β Beta
# Works everywhere. On macOS, first run may need an Administrator for Homebrew.
$ curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash
# Install OpenClaw
$ npm i -g openclaw
# Meet your lobster
$ openclaw onboard
# For those who read source code for fun
$ curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash -s -- --install-method git
# Source checkouts are pnpm workspaces
$ git clone https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git
$ cd openclaw && corepack enable && pnpm install
# Run from source; bundled plugins use extensions/* deps
$ pnpm openclaw onboard

## Quality Options For The Containers

Truth be told, there isn't a standard rating system across America to determine the quality of
shipping containers. However, there are some common practices across the industry and acceptable
metrics that most companies leverage in advertising and for warranty purposes. Here's how we
communicate them with our customers on [new or used containers][32]:

### New Containers (aka One-Trip)

What is considered a "new shipping container" is as close as you can get to it being made right here
in America. Unfortunately, over 95% of all containers in the world are made overseas and arrive here
in the US by large cargo ships carrying dozens of them. So purchasing a brand new container in
Florida simply means it will have the fewest possible miles on it from creation to your door.



The good news is if you purchase it new, it will only have one shipment in the ocean and thus likely
have no visible damage at all. Obviously, it's completely water tight and ready for your usage. In
some instances, we can even let you choose your color if you select it at purchase (but that's not
always the case so ask first).

### Cargo Worthy Containers (CW)

If you want the next highest quality container with out the "new" price tag, you'll want a high
grade cargo-worthy container. These containers have had some trips across the sea, but still
maintain the level of international shipping standards created by the shipping industries. These are
solid boxes that are completely water tight and still look very good. It's similar to buying a used
car that's only got 30,000 miles on it.

[shipping containers for sale jacksonville florida]

### Wind & Water Tight Containers (Grade B or WWT)

The "B Grade" type of containers are next on the list for quality. They have made plenty of trips
across the ocean and it shows. They have highly noticeable damage and often come with rust on
corners. They are still water tight upon delivery, but may experience some issues soon after without
some DIY repairs. These boxes are no longer certifiable to handle shipments across the ocean. We
offer a very limited warranty on these types of containers simply because they are well used.

### As-Is Condition Containers (Grade C)

The "C Grade" containers are ones we do not typically recommend to our customers. These containers
do not come with any warranty from our company and it's because they have the most damage and often
are not watertight. If you are a handy DIY person and want to repair these boxes to make them
watertight, we can find some for you. These will be the absolute cheapest on the market, but
hopefully you understand why. They likely have holes and rust in several areas or maybe a door that
doesn't properly seal keep water and rodents out.

## What types of shipping containers do you sell?

We offer a wide range of containers including 20ft, 40ft, 45ft, and 53ft shipping containers. You

A one-trip container is nearly new and has only been used once to transport cargo. These containers
are in excellent condition and ideal for storage, office use, or container homes.

#### Frequently Asked Question

## What types of shipping containers do you sell?

We offer a wide range of containers including 20ft, 40ft, 45ft, and 53ft shipping containers. You
can choose from standard, high cube, open top, double door, and custom-modified options to suit your
needs.

## 2. Are your containers new or used?

We sell both new (one-trip) and used shipping containers. All containers are inspected for
structural integrity and weather resistance to ensure durability and security.

## How much does a shipping container cost?

Prices vary based on size, condition, and location. 20ft containers generally start at a lower
price, while 53ft high cube containers and custom options cost more. Contact us for a free quote
based on your needs and delivery location.

## Do you deliver shipping containers across the USA?

Yes, we provide nationwide delivery for all container sizes. Our logistics team ensures fast and
affordable container delivery right to your home, business, or job site.

## Can I customize a container before buying it?

Absolutely! We offer container customization services such as adding roll-up doors, insulation,
windows, ventilation, electrical setups, and more. Just tell us your requirements.

## What is a one-trip container?

A one-trip container is nearly new and has only been used once to transport cargo. These containers
are in excellent condition and ideal for storage, office use, or container homes.

We are shipping Container wholesalers- A cargo and freight container wholesaler is a distributor of
large boxes for storage and shipping of merchandise. Companies use these containers to transport
materials and products locally, domestically, and internationally. However of recent years the Self

containers for a wide variety of purposes and cargo. A freight container can be used to import
merchandise into another country, while a storage container can be used for storing materials in
your factory or self storage facility. Also different types of containers and sizes are good for
boats, trucks, planes, and railroad use. It all depends on where you are shipping to and what type
of product you have.

requirement can be met. These days, shipping containers aren’t just used by logistics companies and
businesses shipping cargo and freight overseas. ISO shipping containers and ISO cargo containers of
all types have been used for housing, field offices, power generation stations, self storage and
even emergency response units.

We are shipping Container wholesalers- A cargo and freight container wholesaler is a distributor of
large boxes for storage and shipping of merchandise. Companies use these containers to transport
materials and products locally, domestically, and internationally. However of recent years the Self
Storage industry has picked up on this useful steel box and we see hundreds of these across the
globe built into self storage yards check out our website at [www.selfstorageyards.com][102].
Whether you need to export your products with a controlled temperature box, or need a large storage
container for transportation on a flatbed, we can help you.There are many different types of
containers for a wide variety of purposes and cargo. A freight container can be used to import
merchandise into another country, while a storage container can be used for storing materials in
your factory or self storage facility. Also different types of containers and sizes are good for
boats, trucks, planes, and railroad use. It all depends on where you are shipping to and what type
of product you have.

During the 20th century, standardisation of the container industry ( see our info on this
[www.shippingcontainertraders.com][103] ) resulted in increased efficiency of the unloading and
loading process at the ports. This further resulted in a higher volume of trade worldwide. Today,
almost every product we used has spent some time in a raw steel container. New generation super
ships are carrying greater numbers than ever before.

## Tampa Quality Options For The Containers

In all honesty, there isn't a standard rating system across America that determines the quality of
shipping containers. However, there are some common practices across the industry and acceptable
metrics that most companies leverage in advertising and for warranty purposes. Here's how we have
found is best to communicate them with our customers so they understand what type of container they
can order here in Tampa:

### New Containers (aka One-Trip)

What is considered a "new shipping container" is as close as you can get to it being made here in
the USA. However, more than 90% of all containers in the world are made overseas and arrive here in
the states by large cargo ships carrying dozens (or hundreds) of them. So buying a brand new
shipping container in Tampa simply means it will have the fewest possible miles on it from when it's
built to your property.



The good news is if you purchase it new, it will only have one shipment across the ocean and thus
likely have no visible damage. Obviously, it's completely water tight and ready for your usage. In
some instances, we can even let you choose your color if you select it at purchase (but that's not
always the case so ask first).

### Cargo Worthy Containers (CW)

If you want the next highest quality container with out the "new" price tag, you'll want a high
grade cargo-worthy container. These containers have had some trips across the ocean, but still
maintain the level of [international shipping standards][28] created by the shipping industries.
These are solid containers that are completely water tight and still look very good. It's similar to
buying a used car that's only got 25,000 miles on it.

[shipping containers for sale lakeland florida]

### Wind & Water Tight Containers (Grade B or WWT)

The "B Grade" type of containers are next on the list for quality. They have made plenty of trips
across the ocean and it shows. They have highly noticeable damage and often come with rust on
corners. They are still water tight upon delivery, but may experience some issues soon after without
some DIY repairs. These containers are no longer certifiable to handle shipments across the ocean.
We offer a very limited warranty on this type of shipping container simply because they are well
used.

### As-Is Condition Containers (Grade C)

The "C Grade" containers are ones we do not typically recommend to our customers. These containers
do not come with any warranty from our company and it's because they have the most damage and often
are not watertight. If you are a handy DIY person and want to repair these containers to make them
watertight, we can find some for you. These will be the absolute cheapest on the market, but
hopefully you understand why. They likely have holes and rust in several areas or maybe a door that
doesn't properly seal keep water and rodents out. Understand that yes we will get this shipping
container for you if you want, but once we finalize delivery, it's all in your hands.

## F.A.Q.

### What is TimeToCargo and who is it for?

TimeToCargo is a shipment visibility platform for companies and logistics professionals managing sea
and rail shipments across multiple carriers. It brings data from shipping lines and rail operators
into a single interface, helping logistics teams track shipments, review transportation events, and
identify schedule changes in one place.

### Which shipping lines does TimeToCargo support?

TimeToCargo supports more than 100 shipping lines and rail operators, including Maersk, MSC, CMA
CGM, COSCO, Hapag-Lloyd, ONE, OOCL, Evergreen, HMM, Yang Ming, ZIM, and regional carriers. The
complete and current list is available on [the Shipping Lines page][27].

### How does TimeToCargo standardize data from different carriers?

Carrier information is collected and presented in a unified format. TimeToCargo standardizes
shipment statuses and locations so that users can work with data from different carriers in one
consistent interface.

### Does TimeToCargo notify users about important shipment changes?

Yes. TimeToCargo identifies delays and cases where a shipment is ahead of schedule by comparing
planned and actual transportation dates. Notifications are displayed in the Personal Account and
included in email digests.

Yes. All core shipment tracking features are available through the Personal Account. API integration
and webhooks are also available for connecting TimeToCargo with internal systems. See [the
Integration page][28] for details.

TimeToCargo publishes a Service Level Agreement covering support hours, response times, service
features, incident classification, and compensation conditions. Carrier, port, and terminal data may
sometimes be delayed or incomplete. These external data issues are handled separately from the
availability of the TimeToCargo platform. See [the SLA page][29] for details.

Trafalgar Cases designs and manufactures bespoke wooden packaging to protect valuable, complex, and
non-standard items during transport and storage.

# Bespoke Wooden Packaging for Shipping, Export and Storage

Trafalgar Cases designs and manufactures bespoke wooden packaging to protect valuable, complex, and
non-standard items during transport and storage.

[Large custom crate to transport engines]

With over 60 years of British manufacturing experience, we support businesses that cannot afford
damage, delays, or uncertainty. Every solution is built to order, designed around the item, its
handling requirements, and the conditions it will face.

## Built for When Standard Solutions Are Not Enough

Our packaging is used when:
* Items are high-value, fragile, or irreplaceable
* Dimensions or weights fall outside standard packaging
* Export or overseas shipping is involved
* Long-term storage or repeated handling is required

From single specialist units to repeat industrial projects, we focus on protection, reliability, and
practicality – not off-the-shelf compromises.

Trafalgar Cases designs and manufactures bespoke wooden packaging to protect valuable, complex, and
non-standard items during transport and storage.

# Bespoke Wooden Packaging for Shipping, Export and Storage

Trafalgar Cases designs and manufactures bespoke wooden packaging to protect valuable, complex, and
non-standard items during transport and storage.

[Large custom crate to transport engines]

With over 60 years of British manufacturing experience, we support businesses that cannot afford
damage, delays, or uncertainty. Every solution is built to order, designed around the item, its
handling requirements, and the conditions it will face.

## Built for When Standard Solutions Are Not Enough

Our packaging is used when:
* Items are high-value, fragile, or irreplaceable
* Dimensions or weights fall outside standard packaging
* Export or overseas shipping is involved
* Long-term storage or repeated handling is required

From single specialist units to repeat industrial projects, we focus on protection, reliability, and
practicality – not off-the-shelf compromises.

# We supply the world

Our fleet of more than 7 million TEUs of owned and managed containers is carried by the world's
major shipping lines. They are the building blocks that form the foundation of global trade. Our
containers help facilitate the safe and efficient transport of essential goods and supplies on their
journey to support economic growth, bring cultures together and build a better world.

We have been leasing and selling new and used cargo containers worldwide longer than any other
company. Our scale gives us unrivaled container supply, allowing us to bring a unique mix of
creative, lease, sales, and purchasing solutions to meet all of your container needs.

We are known for our unbeatable service and local expertise. With 21 global offices, you can rely on
our friendly, international team to be ready whenever and wherever you need us. Our core values are
the guiding force – always striving to operate with integrity, reliability, creativity, excellence,
quality, and a long-term view.

Our expansive fleet encompasses a full range of new and used intermodal equipment, including Dry
Containers, Refrigerated Containers, Open Tops, Flatracks, Roll Trailers, ISO Tanks, and Chassis.

We’re the biggest for a reason, contact our friendly experts and experience Triton’s world-leading
service and cost savings today.

Our Services
Lease containers
Whether you are looking for 10 or 10,000 containers, short-term or long-term, we offer a variety of
leasing structures to meet your needs.
[Learn about leasing containers][121]
Our Services
Buy containers
If you are looking to purchase containers outright, Triton Container Sales is the global leader in
sales of used and new Shipping Containers, Refrigerated Containers, Open-Top Containers, Flatracks,
Container Chassis, and IMO Tanks.
[Learn about buying containers][122]
Explore our product range

Our fleet of over 7 million twenty-foot equivalents (“TEU”) of owned and managed containers,
encompasses a full range of intermodal equipment for lease and sale.
Scroll and click below for more information.

# We supply the world

Our fleet of more than 7 million TEUs of owned and managed containers is carried by the world's
major shipping lines. They are the building blocks that form the foundation of global trade. Our
containers help facilitate the safe and efficient transport of essential goods and supplies on their
journey to support economic growth, bring cultures together and build a better world.

We have been leasing and selling new and used cargo containers worldwide longer than any other
company. Our scale gives us unrivaled container supply, allowing us to bring a unique mix of
creative, lease, sales, and purchasing solutions to meet all of your container needs.

We are known for our unbeatable service and local expertise. With 21 global offices, you can rely on
our friendly, international team to be ready whenever and wherever you need us. Our core values are
the guiding force – always striving to operate with integrity, reliability, creativity, excellence,
quality, and a long-term view.

Our expansive fleet encompasses a full range of new and used intermodal equipment, including Dry
Containers, Refrigerated Containers, Open Tops, Flatracks, Roll Trailers, ISO Tanks, and Chassis.

We’re the biggest for a reason, contact our friendly experts and experience Triton’s world-leading
service and cost savings today.

Our Services
Lease containers
Whether you are looking for 10 or 10,000 containers, short-term or long-term, we offer a variety of
leasing structures to meet your needs.
[Learn about leasing containers][121]
Our Services
Buy containers
If you are looking to purchase containers outright, Triton Container Sales is the global leader in
sales of used and new Shipping Containers, Refrigerated Containers, Open-Top Containers, Flatracks,
Container Chassis, and IMO Tanks.
[Learn about buying containers][122]
Explore our product range

Our fleet of over 7 million twenty-foot equivalents (“TEU”) of owned and managed containers,
encompasses a full range of intermodal equipment for lease and sale.

essential goods and supplies on their journey to support economic growth, bring cultures together,

Triton leases and sells high-quality intermodal shipping containers and related equipment through a
global network of more than 400 independent, third-party depots and locations worldwide. Our
extensive global scale enables us to deliver best-in-class service while also operating with the
lowest cost ratios in the industry.

Our people
We take great pride in our talented global team, which reflects the countries and communities we
serve. At Triton, our people and our culture are the driving force behind our success. We enhance
our creativity, problem-solving, and customer service capabilities by embracing a wide range of
perspectives.

Our company
Triton International is the world's largest and most reliable container leasing company. We provide
our customers with efficiency and certainty in an unpredictable world. Our customers rely on our
extensive worldwide network and large equipment inventory to meet their needs and help keep global
commerce moving forward.
